title: Per-direction queue-depth readout overflows the 300 px QoS panel plate
evidence:
QOS_PANEL_W :: 300
...
			qdx := QOS_PANEL_X + 10 + i32(rl.MeasureTextEx(app.view.font, cstring(raw_data(label_c)), 14, 1).x) + 8
			for dir in 0..<pp.PORT_DIR_COUNT {
				draw_text(app, dirs[dir], qdx, qd_y + 3, 14, p.ink_soft_text)
				qdx += 30
				for lane in 0..<3 {
					depth := pp.port_lane_count(&app.state, &app.cat, bi, u8(dir), u8(lane))
					...
					draw_text(app, depth_str, qdx, qd_y + 3, 14, col)
					qdx += 34
				}
				qdx += 10
			}
detail: The two direction groups advance 2×(30+3×34)+10 = 274 px after the ~150 px "queue depth (bound N):" label, ending ~454 px — ~140 px past the plate's right edge (QOS_PANEL_X 12 + QOS_PANEL_W 300 = 312). The pre-change single-direction row ended ~282 px, inside.
recommended_fix: Fit the readout inside the plate: stack fwd/rev on two rows, or drop the per-direction label pitch (e.g. 30→22, 34→26) so 2 groups + label stay under QOS_PANEL_W-20.
